title: Protobuf Serialization
concept: Protocol Buffers (protobuf) serialization in XIOM — compact binary encoding with schema evolution for efficient data storage and transmission.
why: JSON is human-readable but verbose. Protobuf is binary and compact — 3-10x smaller and faster to parse, with backward-compatible schema evolution.
tips: Protobuf field numbers must be UNIQUE within a message — plan your schema carefully
Never remove or reuse field numbers — mark as deprecated instead
Protobuf is ideal for internal service communication, file formats, and data storage
Combine protobuf with gRPC for end-to-end typed, compact, fast APIs
common_mistakes: Changing field types — Int32 to Int64 is OK, but Int32 to String breaks compatibility
Assuming required fields — proto3 has no required fields, all are optional with defaults
Not documenting schema versions — without comments, field numbers are meaningless
